dedupe_keys.name: hanoi informal recyclable waste aggregator facilities and characteristics

description: This workbook describes 975 informal recyclable-waste aggregator facilities in Hanoi, Vietnam. Hanoi Architectural University researchers record fourteen variables covering urban or rural classification, owner characteristics, establishment periods, approximate ground area, storage and building materials. The article describes initial 2017–2019 surveys with updates in 2020, 2023 and 2024; the current deposit classifies places using the 2025 administrative reorganisation. Mendeley version 3 provides the XLSX free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Coverage is surveyed facilities with missing observations marked N/A. Although the article describes photographs, interviews and material transactions, the current repository inventory lists only one workbook, so those broader materials are not assumed available. These limits affect reconstruction of time-varying flows or a complete facility network. Modellers could use facility characteristics to represent informal collection actors in recycling simulations. model-comses-rac-serious-game-solid-waste-vietnam provides a related modelling context. No respondent records or facility details were downloaded, and the noncommercial no-derivatives licence remains explicit.
